text: Chapter 7: Upheaval in Ultimea@Tragedy in the Jail
Go save the people who are confined in Cuervo Jail\nand about to be executed!
Break the doors at the jail and rescue people!
You have saved all the people confined on the 1st and 2nd\nfloor. Keep going and save the people on the 3rd floor!
The people on the 3rd floor are about to be executed\nat the roof. Hurry up and save them!
Defeat Gwaimol the Black Knight who killed the innocent\npeople in the cruel way!
